It contains a handover from auditor marked To: reconciler, then a block headed "Handover from scheduler" with no To: line, and two signature lines ("Signed, auditor" and "Signed, reconciler"). I cannot tell which handover is meant for me, so I have not forwarded it.
Please resend it as a single handover addressed to extractor, from the sender who is originating the bank-detail change, with the supplier, the sort code and account number, the effective date, the deadline, the priority, and the approval reference (FD-0926) exactly as you intend them.
